Title: Generally available: Azure Static Web Apps now supports .NET 8

Body.Content:
Azure Static Web Apps now supports .NET 8, enabling you to build and deploy frontend and full-stack .NET 8 web applications.

With .NET 8 support, you can build and deploy Blazor WebAssembly apps to Azure Static Web Apps. You can also deploy .NET 8 managed functions to your Azure Static Web Apps.

Azure Static Web Apps support for .NET 8 follows the .NET 8 lifecycle. To learn more, please refer to the .NET support policy.

Learn more about Azure Static Web Apps Blazor Support.
